scientific_integrity: The source constructs the family and provides the automorphism-to-stabilizer reduction. The further calculations are explicitly derived and qualified; no independent audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic zero. Full automorphism groups computed for one explicit smooth one-parameter family; not a classification of every linear subsystem. The generic S4 fact is classical; novelty is limited to the full exceptional GL2 group, exact smooth jump, and normal representation; possible unindexed classical coverage remains.
title: A binary-cubic normal slice at a fourfold automorphism jump
